description: Search the SupplyClub catalog of eco-friendly foodservice packaging and supplies. Returns matching products with pricing, case configuration, and eco attributes, plus facets listing valid brand/material/category filter values for refinement.

brand.description: Filter by brand name (see facets.brands in results)

category.description: Filter by category name (see facets.categories in results, or list_categories)

material.description: Filter by material (see facets.materials in results)

name: search_products

compostable.description: Compostable. Absent when we have no rating; absent is not false.

diameter_in.description: Diameter (the largest stated), inches; null when not stated

height_in.description: Height, inches; null when not stated

length_in.description: Length, inches; null when not stated

source.description: lwh = positional L x W x H; labelled = from Length/Width/Height/Diameter labels; unparsed = the display string did not parse (all values null)

width_in.description: Width, inches; null when not stated

dimensions_parsed.description: `dimensions` parsed to numbers, in inches; null when the product has no dimensions

freezable.description: Freezer safe. Absent when we have no rating; absent is not false.

microwaveable.description: Microwave safe. Absent when we have no rating; absent is not false.

oven_safe.description: reheat_only = warming a cooked item, never baking. Absent when we have no rating.

price.description: Guest price, USD per case (see case_configuration)

purchasable.description: false = archived reference item; cannot be ordered

recyclable.description: Recyclable. Absent when we have no rating; absent is not false.

url.description: Storefront page URL, tagged for agent attribution (utm_source=mcp)

title: Search SupplyClub catalog
